timing_boundary: resident normalized query token vectors to final ranked document IDs; includes search, aggregation, selection, exact reranking, and top-k

runtime.affinity_note: initial_cpu_affinity is captured when benchmarking.py is imported; process_cpu_affinity is the calling thread at metadata capture and may be narrowed to one OpenMP place after a native kernel runs

config.c_zero_meaning: rerank every unique document in the candidate pool
config.metric: squared L2 on L2-normalized tokens; similarity = 1 - distance/2
